Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1983
PRESIDENT'S
PENSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE VIII OF
1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the President's Pension Act, 1974
[Gazette of
Pakistan, .Extraordinary, Part I, 26th February, 1983]
No. F. 17 (I)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the President's Pension
(Amendment) Ordinance, 1983.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2, Act IX of 1975

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1983
PRESIDENT'S
PENSION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1983
ORDINANCE VIII OF
1983
An Ordinance
further to amend the President's Pension Act, 1974
[Gazette of
Pakistan, .Extraordinary, Part I, 26th February, 1983]
No. F. 17 (I)/83-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
2. Amendment of section 2, Act
IX of 1975.-In the President's Pension Act, 1974 (IX of 1875), in section
2,-
(a) in. subsection (1), for the
words "four thousand rupees" the words and comma "four thousand
five hundred rupees, free from all taxes" shall be substituted ; and
(b) in subsection (2),-
(i) for the words
"twenty-five thousand rupees" the words "fifty thousand
rupees" shall be substituted ; and
(ii) for the words "two
lakhs of rupees" the words "two lakhs and fifty thousand rupees"
shall be substituted.
